 Strictly Power

 The VP450P is crafted for quality, performance and incredible value. This entry-level solution gives you everything you
 need in a power supply. No twinkly lights or glittery paint jobs – a 120 mm fan for effective and quiet cooling, dual
 +12V rails for amazingly stable power, heavy-duty protection circuitry and Active Power Factor Correction (PFC) that
 saves money on corporate power bills. And it comes with all the assurance of Antec’s AQ2 Antec Quality 2 year limited
 warranty. All the features, none of the waste: for builders that are strictly business, the VP450P is strictly power.
